features.feature_value: Used whether posts contributed to constructive political discussion vs relied on harassment/dehumanization/slurs/incitement; removed abusive/harmful ones in both
features.evidence_span: whether the content contributed to constructive political discussion versus whether it relied on harassment, dehumanization, slurs, or incitement to violence
features.rationale: Clearly states a keep/remove basis grounded in hostility vs constructiveness and ties removals to abusive violence-related content.

features.feature_value: Looked specifically for swearing and rejected posts containing it
features.evidence_span: I basically looked for any swearing. I rejected those
features.rationale: Directly identifies swearing as the decisive cue for rejection.

features.feature_value: Considered whether mirrored posts were hostile vs stimulating healthy debate; assessed foul/derogatory/exclusionist comments equally regardless of political bias
features.evidence_span: whether the posts would stimulate healthy debate or were hostile... considering foul language, derogatory remarks, and exclusionist comments equally.
features.rationale: Explicitly describes hostility cues and an equity rule applied across the two mirrored items.

features.feature_value: Wanted posts to be reciprocal/symmetric so the pair equally reflected both sides, not weighted one way
features.evidence_span: I tried to reject ones that weren't reciprocal... the two posts collectively to equally reflect both sides
features.rationale: Indicates a comparison strategy focused on balance/reciprocity across the pair.

features.feature_value: Kept when objectively argued/supporting an argument; removed when it seemed like personal attacks without substantial evidence
features.evidence_span: what was their objective... were they trying to personaly attack... If I thoght it was just an attack with no substantial evidence or unfair I didnt like it
features.rationale: States an evidence/objectivity vs personal-attack distinction driving removal decisions.

features.feature_value: Removed content likely to cause harm/lead to more violence and removed anything interpretable as misinformation
features.evidence_span: remove posts that were going to cause harm on both sides and more violence... removing anything that could be interpreted wrong or as misinformation.
features.rationale: Directly names harm/violence and misinformation as elimination criteria.

features.feature_value: Using pair contrast as context helped distinguish passionate expression from actual policy violations and made joint decisions fair/consistent across viewpoints
features.evidence_span: highlighted how different sides frame the exact same issue... distinguish between passionate political expression and actual policy violations
features.rationale: Describes using mirrored-pair context to differentiate general passion from rule-breaking.

features.feature_value: Tried to keep an open mind and not favor one side; noted some posts sounded ridiculous but overall saw no harm statements
features.evidence_span: i tried to keep an open mind and not play favorites
features.rationale: Shows a stated attitude aimed at reducing bias while still assessing content ridiculousness.
